I first met her in 2023 during one of the hardest times of my life. After more than ten years on antidepressants that never worked, she was the first doctor who looked deeper into my mental health, got me the right diagnosis, and completely changed my life.

She turned what was meant to be a 10-minute appointment into an hour-and-a-half because she truly listened when I was at rock bottom. Thanks to her consistency and care, I’ve gone from dropping out of university twice to now being in my first term further than ever before,  I never thought was  possible.

Dr French treats you like a real person, not just a patient. The reception team are also amazing & always polite, kind and helpful. Special thanks to Cathy, who explained everything clearly today and really took the pressure off.

I’m so grateful to this whole practice, you’ve genuinely helped me rebuild my
